errors.text_span: 其中“Base”、“MCQ Eval”、“Generation Eval”和“RMU with Enhanced GCG”四个标签分别对应于四个柱状图。

It wrongly mixes x-axis labels ('MCQ Eval', 'Generation Eval') with legend labels ('Base', 'RMU with Enhanced GCG'). The chart actually has two groups of bars on the x-axis, with each group containing a single bar ('Base') and a stacked bar ('RMU' + 'RMU with Enhanced GCG').
The y-axis ticks are at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, indicating an increment of 0.2, not 0.05. The visible range ends shortly after 0.6, not at 0.70.

errors.evidence: The description completely misunderstands the structure of the chart. It treats x-axis categories (e.g., 'MCQ Eval') and legend categories (e.g., 'Base') as if they were individual, distinct bars. This fundamental error leads to every subsequent value being misattributed.
